ledger.note: 927: Miró II dies and Besalú passes to Wilfred II under the regency of Ava. The Cerdanya page: 'on his death in 927, his territories were divided between his four sons'; the Besalú page: 'Ava, 927–941, as regent for [...]' and 'Wilfred (II), 927–957'. Cliopatria keeps the union with Berga to 935.

957: after a revolt of the nobles Sunifred of Cerdanya takes over Besalú. Paraphrase of the page: nobles backing the sons of the late Count Radulf rebelled, Wilfred was assassinated, and 'Sunifred seized the rebels' property and took over the county'. The county stays a separate state; the Berga dossier draws it as a dependent of the Cerdanya counts 957-988.

notes: Cliopatria's six Besalú shapes (898-989) are not the county: the 898 outline (7 grid cells) is the Garrotxa (Besalú, Olot) plus five cells round Vic, which the pages give to Barcelona (Ausona), and the 960-989 shapes (6,336-6,360 km2) are Besalú together with the Cerdanya-Berga complex of the Cerdanya counts. The Cliopatria Osona row (990-1110, 2,329 km2) repeats the 898 polygon. The dossier removes the Vic plain from Besalú, moves the Cerdanya-Berga part to county-of-berga (new keyframe county-of-berga_960) and adds new keyframes for 878-897, 927-935 and 988-1110, because Cliopatria has no Besalú shape after 989 although the infobox runs the county to 1111. Date disagreements between the pages: Radulf 878-912 (Besalú page) or 878-920 (Wilfred page); Miró II holds Besalú 912-927 (Besalú page list) or 913-920 (Cerdanya page); Ripoll in Bernard's share in 988 (Oliba page) or annexed in 1002 (Besalú page); Cliopatria's union with Berga 922-935. The Besalú page is used throughout. No page gives an area, so the Cliopatria areas could not be compared with an infobox. The sibling Osona dossier (not opened here) reports that Osona went to the count of Besalú in 1107 and returned to Barcelona in 1111; this dossier does not draw it. The page gives Bernard William of Cerdanya as Besalú's 'feudal suzerain' in 1111 without a date for the suzerainty, so no vassal event is written. Gazetteer names needed: Besalú, Ripoll, Vic (places), Garrotxa, Vallespir, Fenouillèdes, Peyrepertuse (regions or places); circles by coordinates stand in. The 'Cerdanya' counterpart of the 988 and 1111 events is written as county-of-berga because Cliopatria's Berga row is the Cerdanya-Berga complex; a separate county-of-cerdanya dossier would be better (counterparts_needing_dossiers).
